headline: Who Will Take Iraq Now That the US Has Left: 10 Countries Already Dividing Its Oil
summary: The United States completed the withdrawal of its last forces from Iraq on September 30, 2026. Foreign operators, buyers, pipelines and energy contracts still shape Iraqi oil flows, the article says.
why: Iraq is one of the largest oil producers in OPEC, and its export arrangements with foreign companies and buyers influence global crude supply.

original_headline: Quién se queda con Irak ahora que EE.UU. se fue: 10 Países que ya se reparten su petróleo
